To ride across or beyond something.

examples.text: Around 50 people were evacuated from a rush-hour London Overground service on October 12, after an eight-car train overrode the buffers at Enfield Town station.

glosses: To ride over the top of something, usually forcibly.

examples.text: Separation of the caboose from the VAN train had caused the train to go into emergency braking and when Extra 3119 West struck the third rack car, the car overrode the locomotive, destroyed the remaining superstructure, and caused the locomotive to overturn the north rail. examples.text: In automotive design, safety should override lesser factors such as cosmetics and corner-cutting.

examples.text: How the cat runs is defined in the method run() of the class Cat, which overrides the same method with the same signature of superclass called Mammal.
